task: Deliver authenticated POST /api/articles/:slug/comments as its own API PR stacked above PR #60.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated POST /api/articles/:slug/comments stores a trimmed, non-whitespace body of at most 10,000 characters, assigns the token user as author, and returns HTTP 201 with the { comment } envelope serialized using the shared comment serializer.
Requests without a valid token return 401; unknown article slugs return 404; blank, whitespace-only, oversized, and client-supplied authorId input are rejected without creating a comment.
Generated Swagger and static OpenAPI document the POST request, maxLength 10000, auth and response/error contracts; this PR adds no comment GET or DELETE route.
blastRadius: comment request validation and generated Swagger
contracts: one API endpoint per PR; base is Phase 5A PR #60
body is trimmed, non-whitespace, and limited to 10,000 characters
author identity comes from the token subject and is never client-controlled
